target: observe_push.sh — flag off (or creds missing) means a clean no-op, exit 0
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic/observability; cp "$FIXTURES/obs-events.jsonl" .agentic/observability/events-20260728.jsonl; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_push.sh" 2>/dev/null; EC1=$?; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true,"stack":{"enabled":true}}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset O2_URL O2_AUTH; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_push.sh" 2>/dev/null; EC2=$?; CUR=false; [ -f .agentic/observability/state/push-cursor.json ] && [ "$(jq 'length' .agentic/observability/state/push-cursor.json)" != "0" ] && CUR=true; jq -n --argjson e1 "$EC1" --argjson e2 "$EC2" --argjson cur "$CUR" '{flag_off: $e1, no_creds: $e2, cursor_advanced: $cur}'
